name: Runtime Lifecycle Model — State Machine Definition
description: Define the unified state machine for app boot, workspace open, project attach, session start, agent execution, artifact production, terminal readiness, cockpit projection, suspend/resume, crash recovery, and session close. The nervous system of the Tribunus runtime.
purpose: Define the complete runtime state machine with valid transitions, crash recovery semantics, and projection lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: State machine covers app boot → workspace → project → session → execution → close
Crash recovery semantics defined: what state survives, what is rebuilt
Projection lifecycle defined: when cockpit updates, what events trigger refresh
Suspend/resume contract specifies what is serialized and restored
